clues.text: This city sits on the south shore of a wide bay, in the south west of a far north island. Steam rises from hot springs in the land around it.
clues.narrowing: Puts the player on a bay in the south west of a far north island.

source.quote: It is located on the southern shore of the Faxaflói bay in southwest Iceland

clues.text: In summer the sun here hardly sets for weeks on end. In mid winter the whole day lasts less than five hours.
clues.narrowing: Rules out most of the world; keeps a far north city of endless summer days and tiny winter days.

source.quote: From 20 May to 24 July, daylight is essentially permanent as the sun never gets more than 5° below the horizon. Day length drops to less than five hours between 2 December and 10 January.

clues.text: In 1845 the nation's old assembly came back to this town and set up there. That move in effect made the town the capital of the island.
clues.narrowing: Shrinks the list to capitals made when an old assembly moved in, in 1845.

source.quote: The location of Alþingi in Reykjavík effectively established the city as the capital of Iceland.

clues.text: No capital city of a free land sits farther north than this one. It is the topmost capital in the whole world.
clues.narrowing: Decisive: the world's northernmost capital of a sovereign land.

source.quote: making it the world's northernmost capital of a sovereign state.

clues.text: The president of Iceland works from this city. His office was set here in 1944, when the land first had a president.
clues.narrowing: Confirms it: Iceland's president has an office in this city.

source.quote: In 1944, the Republic of Iceland was founded and a president , elected by the people, replaced the king; the office of the president was placed in Reykjavík.

reveal.blurb: Norse settlers reached this bay in the year 874 and farmed here for ages. The town was founded as a trading town in 1786, and the nation's assembly moved here in 1845. Today it is a clean, bright port, famed for its long summer days. Reykjavík is the capital of Iceland.
